hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: agent-team: this conversation is about to be COMPACTED - the context window ran past the healthy band. This is a CHECKPOINT SIGNAL, not a stop signal, and NOT a reason to hand work back to the human. Right now: (1) write the current phase's durable artifact to disk if you have not (SPEC.md / RESEARCH.md / PLAN.md / DECISIONS.md / review notes / checkpoint updates) - the artifact is what survives compaction, so it must exist before you lose the window; (2) append anything you decided but have not yet logged to `.planning/DECISIONS.md`, because an unlogged decision is the thing most likely to be lost here; (3) then CONTINUE - hand the remaining work to a freshly spawned subagent with the artifact as its seed, rather than either pushing on in a degraded window or asking the user to restart. Under agent-team 2.0.0 the team is autonomous: 'start a fresh session' is never the answer, a fresh SUBAGENT is. Only stop for an ESCALATION.md section 1 case (security, secrets, prod/money/real people, irreversible or outward-facing, legal interpretation, abuse-shaped work).
